<style id="cdqV2505MobileRecoveryCss">
html.cdq-auth-lock-v2505 .bottom-nav,
html.cdq-auth-lock-v2505 #bottomNav,
html.cdq-auth-lock-v2505 .bottom-navigation,
html.cdq-auth-lock-v2505 nav.bottom-nav{
  display:none!important;
  visibility:hidden!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
}
</style>
<script id="cdqV2505MobileRecoveryJs">
(function(){
'use strict';

let tap=null;
let suppressClickUntil=0;

function selectionActive(){
  try{
    if(document.body.classList.contains('selection-active'))return true;
    if(typeof modeSelectionFichiers!=='undefined'&&modeSelectionFichiers)return true;
  }catch(_){}
  return false;
}

function infoFromTarget(target){
  if(!target||!target.closest)return null;
  if(target.closest('button,a,input,select,textarea,label'))return null;
  const row=target.closest('.file-row');
  if(!row)return null;
  const box=row.querySelector('.file-checkbox[data-file-id]');
  if(!box)return null;
  const id=String(box.dataset.fileId||'');
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,200}$/.test(id))return null;
  let meta=null;
  try{meta=typeof cdqDocumentMeta==='function'?cdqDocumentMeta(id):null;}catch(_){}
  const type=String((meta&&meta.type)||row.dataset.fileType||'').toUpperCase();
  if(type!=='PDF' && type!=='GOOGLE_SHEETS' && !type.includes('SHEET'))return null;
  return {row,id,type:type.includes('SHEET')?'GOOGLE_SHEETS':'PDF',meta:meta||{}};
}

function markOpened(id){
  try{
    if(String(utilisateurCourantRole||'')==='lecture')return;
    fichierOuvertPourModification=String(id||'');
    const meta=(typeof cdqDocumentMeta==='function'&&cdqDocumentMeta(id))||{};
    sessionStorage.setItem('fichierEnModification',String(id||''));
    sessionStorage.setItem('ancienneDateModification',String(meta.dateModification||''));
    sessionStorage.setItem('momentModification',String(Date.now()));
  }catch(_){}
}

function openSheet(id){
  id=String(id||'');
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,200}$/.test(id))return false;
  markOpened(id);
  const web='https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/'+encodeURIComponent(id)+'/edit';
  const intent='intent://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/'+encodeURIComponent(id)+'/edit'+
    '#Intent;scheme=https;package=com.google.android.apps.docs.editors.sheets;'+
    'S.browser_fallback_url='+encodeURIComponent(web)+';end';
  const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=/Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent||'')?intent:web;
  a.target='_top';
  a.rel='noopener';
  a.style.display='none';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  return true;
}

function openPdf(id){
  id=String(id||'');
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,200}$/.test(id))return false;
  markOpened(id);
  try{
    const fn=(typeof window.cdqOpenPdfInternal==='function')
      ? window.cdqOpenPdfInternal
      : (typeof window.cdqOpenPdf==='function'?window.cdqOpenPdf:null);
    if(fn){
      Promise.resolve(fn(id)).catch(function(e){
        try{if(typeof afficherErreur==='function')afficherErreur(e);}catch(_){}
      });
      return true;
    }
  }catch(_){}
  try{if(typeof afficherMessage==='function')afficherMessage('Impossible d’ouvrir ce PDF.',false);}catch(_){}
  return false;
}

function openItem(item){
  return item.type==='GOOGLE_SHEETS'?openSheet(item.id):openPdf(item.id);
}

// Capturer le tap avant les anciens gestionnaires de sélection/swipe.
window.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
  if(selectionActive())return;
  const item=infoFromTarget(e.target);
  if(!item)return;
  tap={item,pointerId:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,moved:false};
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
},true);

window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
  if(!tap||tap.pointerId!==e.pointerId)return;
  if(Math.abs(e.clientX-tap.x)>18||Math.abs(e.clientY-tap.y)>18)tap.moved=true;
},true);

window.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(e){
  if(tap&&tap.pointerId===e.pointerId)tap=null;
},true);

window.addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){
  if(!tap||tap.pointerId!==e.pointerId)return;
  const current=tap;tap=null;
  if(current.moved){suppressClickUntil=Date.now()+700;return;}
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  openItem(current.item);
  suppressClickUntil=Date.now()+1200;
},true);

window.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  const item=infoFromTarget(e.target);
  if(!item)return;
  if(selectionActive())return;
  if(Date.now()<suppressClickUntil){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();return;
  }
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  openItem(item);
  suppressClickUntil=Date.now()+900;
},true);

try{
  window.cdqV19OpenOfflineSheet=openSheet;
  window.cdqOpenSheetStableV2505=openSheet;
  window.cdqV24OpenPdf=openPdf;
  window.cdqOuvrirPdfCommeSheetV2275=openPdf;
}catch(_){}

// Masquer la barre de navigation pendant le NIP/déverrouillage.
function lockVisible(){
  try{
    const inputs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(
      'input[type="password"],input[inputmode="numeric"],input[maxlength="4"]'
    ));
    for(const input of inputs){
      const r=input.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(r.width<2||r.height<2)continue;
      const box=input.closest('form,div,section,main')||input.parentElement;
      const txt=String(box&&box.textContent||'');
      if(/NIP|Déverrouiller|4 chiffres/i.test(txt))return true;
    }
  }catch(_){}
  return false;
}
function syncLock(){
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('cdq-auth-lock-v2505',lockVisible());
}
syncLock();
setTimeout(syncLock,150);
setTimeout(syncLock,700);
try{
  new MutationObserver(function(){clearTimeout(window.__cdqV2505LockTimer);window.__cdqV2505LockTimer=setTimeout(syncLock,40);})
    .observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden']});
}catch(_){}
})();
</script>
